No panel when narrow on Windows:
the pull request, findings and context
Reference: briareus-windows (app/main.c layout, screen_projects.c, screen_conversation.c, screen_panel.c). Other clients match this structure.
Windows · Mac: as drawn. Header buttons collapse to 32px icon squares when they would leave the title under 120px. ⧉ pops the conversation into its own window.
Ctrl+F opens the find bar under the header: Find in conversation · N / M · Previous · Next · Close.
Windows: 🌐 Browser docks as a column in the panel’s place (default 45% of the main area, draggable divider).
iPad: wide layout (split view). iPhone: narrow flow only; the session details open as a sheet over the conversation.
Quest: list beside conversation as separate panels; no details panel — the pull request opens in a browser panel.
Region names (sidebar, canvas, raise, sunken) are the theme.* roles; widths and margins are layout.* in tokens/. Greys only, on purpose.
